what: Hovering a thumbnail switches the photo in the large preview frame to a WebGL version. The plane starts rolled up along the diagonal (−45°) axis (bend 2.2), unrolls in 1s and settles in 2s (power1.out), while the positioning photo inside the frame shrinks from 1.3× to 1× so the plane shrinks with it. The previous photo’s plane fades out in .4s. On first attach, the first photo enters in the same shape and only its size shrinks, over 1.8s with power4.out.

options.dur: Unfold duration (sec) — bend 2.2→0 and scale 1.3→1, default 1
options.bend: Initial bend (radian multiple) — larger pinches more diagonally, default 2.2
options.delay: Wait (s) before the first photo comes in, default 0 — when opening after the loader
options.ease · intro-ease: Curve, default power1.out · initial size power4.out
options.[data-fx-part=thumb]: Thumbnails to hover — paired with photos in order
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Preview frame — photo height is the frame height
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Photo inside the frame (img·canvas, or a placeholder box showing data-label if none) — not visible on screen, used only for the panel’s position, size and texture. Ratio comes from the style aspect-ratio or the image size

from.where: index.html Hero right preview panel (original .p-home-grid-mode__area — three orthographic panel of 20×20 cells, bent from the vertex at −45° and rolled along the x axis by y·u_amount, then returned. On hover u_amount 2.2→0 1s · u_alpha →1 2s · front panel →0 .4s · DOM image scale 1.3→1 1s, first time 1.8s power4.out)

note: The panel is drawn on a single screen-fixed canvas, so nothing is clipped even when it leaves the frame (same as the original). The shader was measured from the original and rewritten with the same values. The original is three-based, while this is raw WebGL. Without WebGL, the placeholder photos are swapped using opacity over the same duration
